fields.name: document_title
fields.description: Title of the document (e.g., रजिस्टर इंतकाल / Register Intkal)

fields.name: village
fields.description: Name of the revenue village (गाँव / Mauza)

fields.name: hadbast_number
fields.description: Revenue estate or village boundary code (हदबसत नंबर)

fields.name: mutation_number
fields.description: Unique serial or mutation identifier (नंबर इंतकाल / नंबर शुमार)

fields.name: khewat_number
fields.description: Khewat or account identifier under mutation (खेवट नंबर)

fields.name: mutation_type
fields.description: Type of mutation or transfer mode (e.g., पारिवारिक हस्तांतरण, बै, हिबा, विरासत)

fields.name: registered_deed_number
fields.description: Registered instrument or wasika reference number (वसीका नं.)

fields.name: deed_date
fields.description: Date of the underlying deed or instrument (दिनांक)

fields.name: consideration_amount
fields.description: Monetary consideration or transaction value stated in the mutation (बदले मूल्य)

fields.name: transferred_share
fields.description: Specific share or portion transferred (हिस्सा मुन्तकिला / भाग)

fields.name: transferred_area
fields.description: Measurement of area transferred (e.g., in Kanal-Marla-Sarsahi / Bigha-Biswa)

fields.name: patwari_report_date
fields.description: Date of entry and report by the Halqa Patwari

fields.name: kanungo_verification_date
fields.description: Date of verification/comparison by Field Kanungo (गिरदावर कानूनगो)

fields.name: sanction_order_text
fields.description: Operative order text issued by the Revenue Officer (e.g., वाका पारिवारिक हस्तांतरण नामा मंजूर है)
fields.gemini: वाका पारिवारिक हस्तांतरण नामा मन्जूर है।
fields.gemma: वाका पारिवारिक हस्तांतरण नामा मंजूर है।
fields.staging: वाका पारिवारिक हस्तांतरण नामा मंजूर है।

fields.name: sanctioning_officer_designation
fields.description: Designation of the approving revenue official (e.g., AC II Grade / Tehsildar / Naib Tehsildar)

fields.name: sanction_date
fields.description: Final order/approval date of mutation by the Revenue Officer

fields.name: mutation_entries
fields.description: Comparative register entries documenting ownership and land details before and after mutation
